style_suffix: Pixar 3D quality, soft dreamy lullaby aesthetic, deep blue and lavender night sky, gentle pastel glow, big-eyed Max (4yo boy, brown hair, pajamas) and Mia (4yo girl, blonde pigtails, pajamas), cinematic 16:9, ultra detailed depth of field
